title: How an Arduino Uno Actually Works ⚡ #shorts
description:
This tiny board can control almost anything. Here's what's on an Arduino Uno and how your code makes it do things.

🧠 The ATmega328P chip: the brain that runs your code
🔌 USB port and power jack: how it gets power and code
📍 Digital pins 0-13 and analog pins A0-A5
⬆️ Uploading code: watch the TX/RX lights flash
💡 The classic Blink sketch on the pin 13 LED

Subscribe to Echo Lab 3D for more how-it-works videos!
